title: Answer: life is what a dissociated alter of cosmic consciousness looks like from outside

statements.text: Life is the extrinsic appearance of dissociation in cosmic consciousness. Cosmic dissociation happens precisely at the level of individual living organisms, so each living organism is an alter, and a living body is the revealed appearance of an alter's dissociative boundary. Metabolism, the shared and differentiating characteristic of all living organisms, is what the activity that maintains a dissociation looks like, and its unique features, such as DNA, morphogenesis and protein folding, unify all life into one clearly distinct natural category.
statements.scope: the 2018 paper The universe in consciousness, the fullest statement of the view in this folder
